newsitem.title: RUSSIA: MC Securities puts leading Russia telecoms on hold.
newsitem.headline: MC Securities puts leading Russia telecoms on hold.

text.p: Profit-taking may slow Russian telecom share appreciation over the next month, MC Securities said in a technical analysis report which recommended holding leading telecom shares.
Natalia Ivanova and Stephen O'Sullivan wrote that Moscow Telecom (MGTS) and St Petersburg telecom (PTS) were top in the field in the report dated March 12.
